newsitem.title: CANADA: BHP Arctic diamond mine OK not imminent.
newsitem.headline: BHP Arctic diamond mine OK not imminent.

text.p: A final government approval of a diamond mine in Canada's Arctic proposed by Broken Hill Proprietary Co Ltd and Dia Met Minerals Ltd is not imminent, a government spokeswoman said on Tuesday.

"I am not able to discuss cabinet schedules but there is not an announcement imminent," Cate McCready, spokeswoman for Canadian Northern Development Minister Ron Irwin, said after a weekly cabinet meeting.
The Canadian government approved the project in principle in August and set a 60-day period for granting final approval. This period was due to expire around October 7.
